request.instructions: never rolls/flips, incredibly fast/high braking and acceleration, turns easily at high and low speeds, overpowered handling please

vehicleTypeReason: The vehicle has FLAG_LAW_ENFORCEMENT in vehicles.meta and emergency siren settings in carvariations/carcols, indicating a police-style emergency vehicle.

security.summary: The pack appears to be a normal data-only FiveM vehicle resource: model and texture assets plus standard vehicle metadata. The included manifest only declares data files and does not contain executable logic, and the importer will generate its own manifest anyway.

repairs.issue: Manifest includes only standard data declarations, but its paths are not independently trusted by the importer.
repairs.action: Ignore the uploaded manifest and regenerate a fresh manifest from recognized files only.
